caption: The drawing depicts a large jug or pitcher positioned in the center of the composition, rendered in shades of gray and white with detailed shading. The pitcher has an ornate handle on the right side and a spout at the top left. Around the body of the pitcher, there is a decorative relief scene featuring several human figures and a horse, standing in what appears to be a pastoral or rural setting with trees. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a rectangular inset sketch, also in gray tones, showing what looks like the same scene depicted on the pitcher’s relief: a group of figures with a horse and an enclosure, set outdoors with trees in the background. In the lower left corner, there is a vertical inset showing a close-up, detailed view of a section of the pitcher’s handle and the decorative relief adjacent to it. The background consists of a pale off-white color with faint rectangular borders outlining the primary pitcher and the two insets. The artist's name, Erasmus Law Durand, is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
